{{Quote|Femnaught in Rimsoo Twelve, over'n Xenoby, she lustin' f'me. She runs alia d'test on d'local crop.|Rorand Zuzz on the female Ugnaught.|<ref name="bs" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an analyst.<ref name="bs" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she was assigned on [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 12]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. She was in charge of analyzing the [[Bota/Legends|bota]] crop being harvested. When she learned that the potency of the bota was slowly weakening, she passed the information to [[Rorand Zuzz]], a male [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] who claimed that she was physically attracted to him.<ref name="bs" />
